name: Sai Desert Camp & Resort
description: A destination resort imagined for travelers who prefer quiet grandeur, intuitive service, and spaces that feel collected rather than decorated.
longDescription: Sai Desert Camp & Resort blends contemporary resort architecture with handcrafted detail, private gardens, cinematic pools, destination dining, and a spa program inspired by elemental rituals. Every suite and villa is designed to be edited, calm, and deeply personal.

heroSlides.title: Stillness, service, and cinematic beauty
heroSlides.text: Wake to textured sunlight, private pools, curated rituals, and a level of hospitality that moves quietly around you.

heroSlides.title: Designed for privacy, framed by nature
heroSlides.text: Generous indoor-outdoor sanctuaries with artisanal materials, sculptural baths, and terraces made for golden-hour dining.

heroSlides.title: Experiences with a sense of occasion
heroSlides.text: From candlelit tasting menus to wedding pavilions and restorative spa journeys, every detail is composed.

experiences.title: Restaurant
experiences.text: A fire-led culinary atelier with seasonal tasting menus, cellar pairings, and private chef tables.

experiences.title: Infinity Pool
experiences.text: Tiered reflective pools, shaded cabanas, sunset service, and quiet adult-only terraces.

experiences.title: Spa
experiences.text: Elemental rituals, hammam suites, hydrotherapy gardens, sound therapy, and expert bodywork.

experiences.title: Conference Hall
experiences.text: A refined grand salon with modular layouts, discreet technology, and dedicated event concierges.

experiences.title: Wedding Venue
experiences.text: Garden pavilions, ocean-view lawns, couture menus, and a full celebration design studio.
